component.summary: Everyday developer tools, together on your desktop

description.p: Format code, convert data, inspect tokens, and run compatible tool pipelines. Input processing happens locally. A bundled CLI supports terminal workflows.
OCR needs Tesseract and language data. This experimental Flatpak candidate does not include OCR dependencies or host package-manager installation.
